LESSON: SINGING GAMES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Singing games

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Singing games. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What songs do you sing able to:- games from the locality and from during play?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. perform singing games • Learners are guided to observe safety while observing own and others safety, while performing singing games
2. practice game etiquette • Individually and in groups, learners for integrity observe game etiquette and share

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SINGING GAMES
This lesson teaches Singing games for Grade 3 MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. perform singing games • Learners are guided to observe safety while observing own and others safety, while performing singing games
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. practice game etiquette • Individually and in groups, learners for integrity observe game etiquette and share
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Singing games using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Singing games above.
2. Explain Singing games to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Singing games.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Singing games with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Singing games important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What songs do you sing able to:- games from the locality and from during play?
2. when performing • Learners perform age-appropriate and other cultures for singing games?
3. Which games can we for enjoyment, coordinated body movements play as we sing?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. perform singing games • Learners are guided to observe safety while observing own and others safety, while performing singing games
2. practice game etiquette • Individually and in groups, learners for integrity observe game etiquette and share
